# MultiDatePick

> MultiDatePick is a Salesforce-native Lightning Web Component suite that drops calendar, scheduling, and resource-booking interfaces into Flows, Lightning Record Pages, App Pages, Home Pages, and Experience Sites with no code. Three components share a configurable base: Date for multi-date selection with ranges and recurring patterns; Date Time for date plus per-date or shared time-slot scheduling with conflict detection; and Booking for resource reservation with capacity tracking, live availability badges, business hours per resource, multi-resource checkboxes, and bulk inline edit mode. The suite renders FIVE interchangeable views from one component (calendar month grid, resource timeline, week-by-hour grid, capacity utilization heatmap, and chronological agenda list), all reading the same records through the same field mappings and saving through the same path, chosen per placement via the view and availableViews properties. The suite ships 60+ configurable properties, six storage shapes (per-date, per-range, per-time-block, parent + sub-blocks, per-resource × date), status-color theming on any picklist, additive-only auto-save, a guided Setup Wizard with JSON import/export and Smart Field Mapping, pre-built configurations, each shipping a default view and switcher list, and built-in translations for 9 languages.

## Core pages

- [MultiDatePick - Salesforce Calendar & Booking LWC Suite](https://multidatepick.com/index.html): Marketing home page introducing the three components, six data shapes, surfaces, and key features.
- [Getting Started - MultiDatePick for Salesforce](https://multidatepick.com/gettingstarted.html): Setup guide covering component selection, install, Setup Wizard configuration, and Flow/page deployment.
- [Date - Salesforce Multi-Date Selection LWC | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/multidatepickdates.html): Reference for the Date component covering use cases, object mapping, Flow + Lightning Page setup, and all properties.
- [Date Time - Salesforce Scheduling LWC | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/multidatepickdatetime.html): Reference for the Date Time component combining date selection with per-date or shared time-slot scheduling.
- [Booking - Salesforce Resource Booking LWC | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-booking-calendar.html): Reference for the Booking component with resource selection, capacity tracking, availability, and inline edit.
- [User Guide - Setup, Configuration & Gotchas | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/user-guide.html): Comprehensive admin guide covering every component, data shape, wizard step, status feature, booking pattern, and common gotcha.
- [App, Home, Experience Pages - Static Record Id | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/home-app-experience.html): Guide to placing MultiDatePick on App Pages, Home Pages, and Experience Sites using the Static Record Id property.

## Optional

- [Config Library: Ready-to-Import Configs | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/configlibrary.html): Library of ready-to-import JSON configurations spanning Date, Date Time, and Booking use cases, each with a default view and switcher list already chosen.
- [Flow Cheat Sheet - Ready-Made Salesforce Flows | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/flowcheatsheet.html): Downloadable Screen Flow bundles with required custom objects for common scheduling scenarios.
- [Accessibility - VPAT 2.5 Conformance Report | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/accessibility.html): VPAT 2.5 self-attested conformance report against WCAG 2.1 A/AA, Revised Section 508, and EN 301 549.
